title: Build XP, leveling, skills, and skins system
description: Implement an XP bar and leveling system (XP thresholds: 100, 250, 500, 1000, 2000). Each level-up grants a skill point. Unlockable skills: Double Jump (level 2), Dash (level 3, quick horizontal burst on shift key), Shield Start (level 5, start each run with a shield). Build a skins system with 5 unlockable player skins (default, ninja, robot, wizard, golden) unlocked at levels 1/2/3/4/5. Add a main menu / character select screen. Persist XP, level, unlocked skills, and skins using localStorage. Dependencies: Task 2, Task 5
